title: How to structure my turn based multiplayer strategy game.
author: Tom_Baron
selftext:
An idea I had watching the news of the war in the middle east was to build a strategy game based on modern warfare, war now is not troops fighting on the ground, its about coercion with missiles and drones, fear, degrading a cities ability to function. 

  
So I built a super early POC to test how this game made me feel, whether it got the dopamine flowing, whether there was challenge and intrigue and it ticked all the boxes. battles are multiplayer and two teams fighting each other but the game geometry restricts players from simply ganging up on one enemy and pummelling them although teaming up can be done. the geometry scales up and down fine without breaking gameplay, you could potentially have 100 vs 100 players. 

I wont go into the mechanics in detail, there are loads of tactical tools at your disposal, special warheads for your missiles, defensive and offensive stances, upgrades etc.  Im miles away from tuning them but it plays nicely.

This needs months of work on it still, graphics need a major overhaul, balancing, strategy between team members, enhancements and additions. UI is terrible and wont look anything like the vid when im done not to mention all the joy of the technical and security stuff for productionising.   


What im trying to work out now though  is how to structure gameplay. Each turn consists of four segments, alternating attack, plan (spend action points and resources to build/repair/develop), defend, plan. You need at least a minute for each part. Probably more for new players. Games are lasting about 20 turns on average with 10 vs 10. Once you are out you are out but players will be playing potentially 80-100 minutes if their city survives. Is that too long?

It could be potentially longer if I let new players join mid battle but then how does a game end? Is it a set number of turns or total annihalation of a side or a set number of hours?

If 100 minutes is too long for a modern game in this format ill have to restructure turns or work out how I can optimise the UI to allow some segments to be performed faster

Also should I create a day per segment option so people who like to dip in and out can do so with games lasting weeks or months? (tribal wars style)

So any input here would be great! I don't know what modern gamer expectations are!  
I don't really know the modern approach to this,
